title: Witness Kilauea from open viewpoints
description: If activity is occurring and safely visible, observe the active volcano from officially open viewpoints. The caldera itself remains an extraordinary landscape.
teaser: If activity is occurring and safely visible, observe the active volcano from officially open viewpoints.
goodToKnow: An eruption is never promised. Check current park alerts, air quality, viewpoint access and visibility before visiting.
